421 Chestnut Street

For Sale & Lease

PRIME OLD CITY LOCATION | 8,000 SF RETAIL / OFFICE SPACE

For Sale: $1,400,000

The Bank Building at 421 Chestnut Street is a prominent historic property located directly across from Independence Mall in Philadelphia’s Old City. The office portion benefits from the building’s distinguished banking-era architecture, featuring impressive ceiling heights, large window lines, and classic detailing that create a prestigious and professional work environment.

Tenants enjoy a highly visible, central location within one of the city’s most walkable districts, with immediate access to transit, dining, and cultural amenities. The property’s position directly across from Independence Mall, a nationally recognized park patrolled by federal law enforcement and the National Park Service, adds an additional layer of safety and security to the surrounding area.

The property offers a unique opportunity to occupy office space within a landmark building that combines historic character with modern infrastructure, making it well-suited for professional, financial, legal, or boutique office users seeking a distinctive Philadelphia address.
